propositions: The bedrock_model_id field and its REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID / tool.rebar.llm bedrock_model_id source are populated but read by nothing.
Setting REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID silently has no effect: no model change, warning, or error.
The Bedrock model id is actually carried by cfg.model as the provider-prefixed string bedrock:<inference-profile-id>, parsed by providers.py.
The remedy is to delete the field, its from_env wiring, docstring lines, and the docs/env-vars.md row rather than wire it up.
A duplicated default literal in bedrock_model.py kept in sync by hand should lose that rationale, while DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID itself stays.
The field never shipped (change 1043 unsubmitted), so removal is not a compatibility break.
